highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews Skia m154 and moves API documentation into compiler XML.
highlights_body: HarfBuzzSharp bindings now follow the bundled native source; review the renamed combining-class member and removed aggregate glyph flag before upgrading.

breaking.title: UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 renamed to CCC132
breaking.body: The HarfBuzz upstream spelling correction retains numeric value 132 but removes the compatibility alias. Replace references to CCC133 with CCC132.

breaking.title: GlyphFlags.Defined removed
breaking.body: The aggregate Defined mask is no longer exposed because it is not an independent option. Combine the concrete glyph flags required by your application instead.

breaking.title: RAW and DNG decoding disabled
breaking.body: The bundled codec no longer decodes RAW or DNG images. Decode these formats with a dedicated library and provide a supported raster image to SkiaSharp instead.

bullets.detail: The bundled renderer moves to Chrome milestone 154 and incorporates current buffer-upload and upstream bug-fix syncs.
Package consumers receive compiler-generated XML documentation sidecars, with public API documentation authored alongside the C# declarations.
HarfBuzzSharp generation now uses the HarfBuzz revision pinned by Skia, keeping supported managed declarations synchronized with the bundled native library.
API documentation remarks can now retain Markdown formatting in generated consumer documentation.

preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9: Preview 1 opened the m154 release line.
preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.2.26471.11: Preview 2 added the m154 engine update, compiler XML documentation, and bundled-source HarfBuzzSharp generation.
preview_summaries.v4.154.0-rc.1.26479.14: Release Candidate 1 disables RAW and DNG image decoding and prepares the line for stable publication.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp bindings now generate from the DEPS-pinned native source. The update corrects the CCC132 member name and removes the aggregate GlyphFlags.Defined mask.
